title: picea vulgaris var. erythrocarpa
intro: Picea vulgaris var. erythrocarpa, commonly known as Japanese black spruce, is a plant species in the family Pinaceae. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, as well as its ability to aid in the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Japanese black spruce include expectorant and bronchodilator effects, which help to relieve symptoms associated with respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
